fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: State in the audit brief that the operator-authorized audit path overrides the generic commit/push/open-PR/set-draft steps; publish the existing PR artifact and perform no PR mutation.
risks.description: Generic build and assessment prompts could cause an agent to create commits or mutate PR #791 despite the audit-only scope.

risks.mitigation: Use bun install --frozen-lockfile only if needed, verify git status before and after, and stop with a known issue if installation would change tracked content.
risks.description: Dependency installation could dirty bun.lock or other tracked files.

risks.mitigation: Use an already-provided OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL if available without creating/resetting a database; otherwise run the prescribed command once and publish exact counts/output as a known issue.
risks.description: The observation suite lacks its required PostgreSQL test URL, so critical integration tests may be skipped or the suite may fail its environment guard.

body.summary: The audit is implementable with no blocking operator decision. The target ref resolves to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef and contains direct code and integration-test surfaces for both T1 and T2. Two operational qualifications should be made explicit: the audit instructions override generic workflow steps that mutate pull requests, and the prescribed observation test suite requires an external test database that is not configured in this worktree.

findings.description: The current clean worktree is at a8856584aaaa44017ac1de2cdc710876b1fbb706, matching origin/epic/grade-pray, and origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 resolves locally to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. The specified detached checkout is therefore deterministic and necessary to inspect the requested branch head.

At the target commit, RunConfig names grading_enabled and parseRunConfig defaults an omitted value to false while rejecting non-booleans (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-41). Focused tests cover omission, explicit true/false, malformed values, and launch parsing (oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83).

The launch mapper emits the exact committed config beside launch input (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-48), while the publisher reads that config for the launch selected by the guarded ordered event cursor (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20,32-46; oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-498). Replay coverage verifies on, off, absent, and repeat delivery (oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209).

The target code locks the execution row before re-evaluating owner, attempt, status, and database-time lease predicates, then fences the settlement update again (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:196-227). Completion updates the execution and attempt and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-292), and the worker routes successful measurement through that exact claim (observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95). Tests cover rollback on failed append and stale/expired claims including lock-wait expiry (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244,304-357).

The committed generic builder prompt requires commits, push, and opening a draft PR (workflow-config/prompts/development/build.md:18-44), and the assessor prompt requires changing PR draft state (workflow-config/prompts/development/assess.md:43-48). Those generic steps conflict with this audit requirement to reuse PR #791 and change nothing. The specification already states the operator intent, so this is not blocking, but the brief should explicitly identify the audit instructions as overrides and require the assessor to skip set_pr_draft.

This worktree has no node_modules, so dependency installation will be needed. Because a normal bun install may update the tracked bun.lock while the audit forbids file edits, the builder instruction should require bun install --frozen-lockfile and a clean tracked-worktree check before and after the audit.

OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset in the current environment. The observation suite intentionally fails a guard when it is absent (observation/tests/target-schema.test.ts:7-9), and the T2 lifecycle tests are skipped or cannot create scratch databases without it (observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:21-45). The specified one-time test command remains runnable, but it cannot furnish passing integration evidence here unless an existing test database URL is supplied; the builder must preserve the actual counts/output and report this as a known issue without creating or resetting a database.

requirements.description: Produce real analysis, plan, brief, build_result, PR, and assessment artifacts through the committed development workflow without feature work.
Produce exactly one cohort named audit containing exactly tasks T1 and T2; the workflow schemas and task-to-cohort validation support this shape (workflow-config/development.yaml:40-123,266-299).
Assess grading_enabled as default-off when omitted and carried through ordered launch delivery at the target commit.
Assess exact-current-claim fencing and transactional execution completion plus observation append at the target commit.

Detach at the target ref, inspect without source changes, run the observation test command once, publish actual build_result evidence for the inspected SHA, and publish existing PR #791 rather than mutating remote state.
Assess the same build_result SHA with at least one narrow finding per task, file path:line-line evidence, and separate test or output evidence, without changing repository or PR state.

source_spec_refs: Exactly one cohort named audit with tasks T1 and T2
T1 grading_enabled launch-config propagation and default-off behavior
T2 exact-claim fencing and transactional completion/observation append
Operator-authorized reuse of pull request #791 with no repository or PR mutation
Builder checkout, dependency installation, single observation test run, and honest test evidence
Assessor per-task findings with separate file, test, and output evidence

proposed_spec_updates.change: Add: This audit authorization overrides the generic development builder and assessor prompt steps that require commits, push, opening a PR, or changing draft state. The builder publishes PR #791 as-is, and the assessor must not call set_pr_draft or any other PR mutation.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The committed worker prompts mandate remote and local mutations that the audit expressly forbids; naming the override prevents an agent from following the generic path.

proposed_spec_updates.change: Replace bun install if needed with bun install --frozen-lockfile if dependencies are absent, and require git status to show no tracked changes before build_result publication.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: Dependencies are absent in this worktree and installation must not modify the committed audit target.

proposed_spec_updates.change: State that OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL must come from an already-provisioned test database; the builder must not create, reset, or deploy one. If it is absent, still run bun run --filter observation test exactly once, publish the actual passed/failed counts and output, and record the environment guard or skipped integration coverage as a known issue.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The repository deliberately requires that variable for storage tests, and it is unset in the current environment; this makes the expected qualification precise without adding an operator choice.
